claim.claim-text: 1. A multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant comprising:

a patient-specific implant component; and, a mass-customized orthopedic implant component customized to engage the patient-specific implant component to create a multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant, wherein the mass-customized orthopedic implant has been subsequently machined to uniquely engage the patient-specific implant component.
2. The multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant of claim 1, wherein:
the patient-specific implant component includes at least one flange of an acetabular orthopedic implant; the mass-customized orthopedic implant component includes an acetabular cup.
3. The multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant of claim 2, wherein the acetabular cup includes porous material fitted into the acetabular cup.
4. The multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant of claim 2, wherein the at least one flange is part of a multi-flange acetabular orthopedic implant.

5. The multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant of claim 4, wherein the at least one flange comprises at least three flanges, where the at least three flanges include a first flange configured to mount to a patient's ilium, a second flange configured to mount to a patient's ischium, and a third flange configured to mount to a patient's pubis.

6. The multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant of claim 1, wherein the mass-customized orthopedic implant component is selected from a plurality of available mass-customized orthopedic implant components based at least in part upon determination of a patient-specific defect classification associated with a patient's abnormal anatomy.
7. The multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant of claim 6, wherein the mass-customized orthopedic implant component is grouped according to at least one of gender, race, and disability.

8. The multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant of claim 1, wherein the patient-specific implant component has a shape precisely matching a shape of a patent tissue comprising at least one of a partial bone, a deformed bone, and a shattered bone.

9. The multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant of claim 1, wherein the mass-customized orthopedic implant component is initially manufactured and provides a foundation on which to engage the patient-specific implant component.
10. The multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant of claim 9, wherein the mass-customized orthopedic implant component is retained in inventory for use as needed.
11. A method of fabricating a multi-component patient-specific orthopedic implant comprising:

structurally modifying a mass-customized orthopedic implant component to create a modified mass-customized orthopedic implant component; and, fabricating a patient-specific orthopedic implant configured to mount to the modified mass-customized orthopedic implant component, the patient-specific orthopedic implant comprising at least one patient-specific contact surface shaped as a negative of a natural residual bone surface of the patient.
12. The method of claim 11, wherein:
the patient-specific orthopedic implant comprises a component of an acetabular orthopedic implant; and, the mass-customized orthopedic implant component an acetabular cup.
13. The method of claim 12, wherein:
said component comprises a flange of the acetabular orthopedic implant; and, the acetabular orthopedic implant comprises a tri-flange acetabular orthopedic implant.
14. The method of claim 12, wherein:

said component comprises an ilium flange, an ischium flange, and a pubis flange of the acetabular orthopedic implant; and, the acetabular orthopedic implant comprises a tri-flange acetabular orthopedic implant.
15. The method of any preceding claim, further comprising applying a porous material to at least a portion of the mass-customized orthopedic implant component.
